subject: Next steps & scheduling: Acme evaluation kickoff / trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + proposed next steps (evaluation kickoff)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Goal: integrate Redwood Inference for customer-facing summarization and search ranking to reduce latency and cost vs current setup.
- Key success criteria: P95 latency < 250ms for autocomplete flows, embedding quality ~ parity with current vendor on our prompt set, and predictable monthly cost under $X.
- Constraints: data residency requirement for EU customers (we discussed options), and a preferred pilot window in June.

Next steps I propose:
1) Schedule an evaluation kickoff (pilot plan, success criteria, prompt set / evals) — goal: align on scope + timeline and get connor involved for the technical deep-dive.
2) Share a trial plan doc and a short prompt set we can use for initial evals.

Are you available for a 60-minute kickoff next week? I have the following windows open (PST):
- Tue 2027-05-18 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–10:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu 2027-05-20 11:00–12:00

If none of those work, send a couple of times and I’ll coordinate. I’ll loop in Connor (SE) for the deep dive and bring a short agenda (pilot scope, evaluation metrics, data/ingest plan, timeline).

Attaching a draft trial plan for reference — happy to iterate.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: acme_trial_plan_v1.pdf (summary: pilot scope, evaluation metrics, sample prompt set)

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acme.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + proposed next steps (evaluation kickoff)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what we discussed. We’re excited to move forward with a short pilot. I spoke with Tom and we can do the kickoff the week of May 18. The Tue and Wed morning options look best for us.

One ask: we’d like the kickoff to include a 20–30 minute technical deep-dive for our infra and data team — they’ll want to confirm the ingest pattern and privacy controls. I’ve CC’d Tom who will surface the right folks if needed.

Suggested: Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–10:00 PST works for our team. If you can confirm, we’ll lock the calendar and share attendees.

Thanks,

Samantha Lee
Head of Product, Search & Relevance
Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com

From: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:42:00 -0700

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up, happy to lead the technical portion. For the deep-dive I’ll plan to cover:
- Architecture: ingest paths, VPC/private deployment options, and tokenization/embedding pipeline
- Data controls: retention, KMS integration, and SOC 2 evidence we can share during procurement
- Pilot runbook: sample prompts, eval harness, and how we’ll measure latency and embedding quality

I’m available Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–10:00 PST. I’ll also prep a short troubleshooting checklist and bring a lightweight test plan for the prompt set.

Connor Obrien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com

P.S. Marissa — I reviewed the trial plan and left one inline note on the expected QPS. I’ll send a short follow-up with questions before the kickoff.
